title: Three retries, win on the third: the reflection repeats itself
shows: A hot-potato task fails the first attempt and retries 1 and 2, then wins on retry 3 (13 steps). The reflections for attempts 2 and 3 are nearly identical. The winning attempt finally uses `heat potato 1 with microwave 1`. The Builder writes a Corrected Error and a Success Process.
why_interesting: Why the retry loop was kept as is: 4 of the 9 retry wins in the check came on attempts 2-3 even though the reflections repeat (the replay itself varies). Also shows the cost: 89 model calls and 270k tokens for this one game.
